# Origino

> Origino is a family-run olive oil processor and bulk supplier of single-origin olive oil from the Orhangazi/Gemlik region of Turkey's Marmara olive belt. Its two-phase extraction facility in Yenikoy, Orhangazi (Bursa province) is under construction, with a design capacity of 500 tonnes per year and full operation targeted for the end of 2027.

Key facts:

- Location: Yenikoy, Orhangazi, Bursa, Turkey (40.5202, 29.3437)
- Sourcing: all oil from groves within the Orhangazi/Gemlik region; no cross-region blending
- Extraction: two-phase system
- Capacity: 500 t/year; seeking 4–5 long-term buyers at 5–10 t per month each
- Status: facility under construction; contract pressing and limited early-harvest samples this season; first full commercial harvest expected 2027/2028
- Packaging: bulk in IBC totes and flexitanks; road and sea logistics to European and Mediterranean ports
- Quality: every batch lab-tested before shipment for free acidity, peroxide value, UV absorbance (K232, K270), polyphenol content and fatty acid profile; full lab report shared with each shipment
- Certification (in preparation, audits follow commissioning in 2027): HACCP + ISO 22000, BRCGS Food Safety, IFS Food, SFDA / ESMA registration
- Buyers served: food manufacturers (canned fish, antipasti, cheese in oil, sauces, bakery, ready meals), bottlers and private-label packers, foodservice/HORECA, importers and distributors
- Markets: Europe, Middle East, Central Asia
- Contact: info@originooils.com, WhatsApp +90 537 433 61 71
